To the left of the departure nodes (white) the acceleration times are given, and to the right of the arrival nodes (blue) there are the braking times. The numbers on the waiting (black) and energy (red) arcs correspond to the weight ρa. For the solid red arcs, they also correspond to the achieved overlap oa, while oa = 0 for the dashed arcs.
